# LeatherCulture

> Genuine leather jackets and modern wear, handcrafted in Pakistan and delivered nationwide. Orders are placed online and paid cash on delivery.

## Key facts
- Country: Pakistan. Delivers nationwide.
- Payment: cash on delivery only.
- Delivery: Rs 250, free on orders of Rs 10,000 or more. Pay in cash when your order arrives. Delivery across Pakistan in 3-5 working days.
- Returns and exchanges: Contact info@leatherculture.shop for the current returns and exchange policy before ordering.
- Price range: Rs 3,400 to Rs 24,900.
- Currency: PKR.
- Contact: info@leatherculture.shop
